_comment: What each step of a LinkBench fetch takes (kvevaluator.datasets.linkbench.fetch plan): disk bytes as measured on the data dir; seconds as recorded by `just fetch-dataset` (tiny: data 15 s with the tool's first build (9 s of it), params 3 s; n1m: data 32 s, params 11 s, the tool already built). download_bytes: none recorded (the tool's clone and its Maven packages, once per machine).
